sloka: ततः स राजा तम् सूतम् सन्न हर्षः सुतम् प्रति ।शोक आरक्त ईक्षणः श्रीमान् उद्वीक्ष्य उवाच धार्मिकः ॥२-१४-५९॥
transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā tam sūtam sanna harṣaḥ sutam prati ।śoka ārakta īkṣaṇaḥ śrīmān udvīkṣya uvāca dhārmikaḥ ॥2-14-59॥

translations.english: The virtuous and glorious king thinking of his son without cheer looked upward with eyes red with tears and said to the charioteer, You are causing my heart excruciating pain with your words.
